people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
translations.bsb: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.
translations.kjv: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
translations.asv: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.
